mapper.select: select mn.* , sc3.C_NAME as constructionContractorName , isa.sa_serial_number as invSettlementSerialNumber , ccc.confirm_serial_number as confirmSerialNumber , ccc.Construction_Drawing as constructionDrawing , ccc.Construction_Image as constructionImage , ccc.Construction_Contractor as constructionContractor , isa.sa_amount_total as saAmountTotal , isa.Sa_Approved_Amt as saApprovedAmt , isa.sa_increase_decrease as saIncreaseDecrease , isa.sa_report_file as saReportFile , isa.sa_audit_report as saAuditReport , ccc.Audit_Unit as auditUnit , sc2.C_NAME as auditUnitName, isa.sa_title as saTitle from inv_settlement_pay mn left join construction_completion_confirm ccc on ccc.id = mn.confirm_complete_id left join inv_settlement_apply isa on isa.Sa_Id = mn.inv_settlement_apply_id left join sys_company sc3 on sc3.C_ID = ccc.Construction_Contractor left join sys_company sc2 on sc2.C_ID = ccc.Audit_Unit where mn.id = #{id}
select mn.* from Inv_Settlement_Pay mn left join Application_Warranty aw on aw.isp_id = mn.id and aw.State = 7 where aw.isp_id is null and mn.State = 7
